title: Us It Recruiter
description:
About the Role We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Technical Recruiter to join our US IT Staffing team. The ideal candidate should have a strong background in end-to-end recruitment for direct clients, with expertise in sourcing and hiring W2 candidates. Prior experience supporting the Automotive, Medical Device, or Manufacturing industries will be highly preferred. Key Responsibilities Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle for US-based IT and Engineering positions, from requirement analysis to candidate onboarding. Source, identify, and engage high-quality candidates through Monster, Indeed, LinkedIn Recruiter Platform (RPS), job boards, social media, and networking channels . Build and maintain a strong pipeline of W2 candidates for contract and full-time opportunities. Screen resumes, conduct initial candidate interviews, assess technical skills, experience, and cultural fit. Negotiate compensation, availability, and employment terms with candidates. Maintain accurate candidate records, recruitment activities, and hiring progress within the Applicant Tracking System (ATS). Ensure timely submissions while maintaining high-quality candidate standards. Develop strong relationships with candidates, clients, and internal account management teams. Stay updated on industry trends, market intelligence, and talent availability within IT, Automotive, Medical Device, and Manufacturing domains. Required Qualifications 2-5 years of experience in US IT Staffing and Technical Recruitment . Proven experience working with direct clients and managing their staffing requirements. Strong experience recruiting W2 candidates for contract and full-time positions. Hands-on expertise with sourcing tools including Monster, Indeed, and LinkedIn Recruiter (RPS) . Experience recruiting for Automotive, Medical Device, Manufacturing, or related engineering domains is highly preferred. Strong understanding of IT technologies, technical job roles, and recruitment processes. Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills. Ability to work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment and manage multiple requirements simultaneously. Preferred Skills Experience with ATS/CRM tools such as Bullhorn, Oorwin, JobDiva, or similar platforms. Knowledge of US employment types including W2, C2C, and 1099. Strong Boolean search and advanced sourcing techniques. Ability to identify passive candidates and build long-term talent pipelines. Why Join Us? Opportunity to work with leading direct clients in cutting-edge industries. Collaborative and growth-oriented work environment. Exposure to challenging technical roles and emerging technologies. Competitive compensation and career advancement opportunities.

Key Skills: US IT Recruitment,W2,Linkedin Recruiter,Technical Recruitment,Talent Acquisition,US Staffing,Sourcing,US IT Staffing
